(() => { const me = window.town.me(); const by = window.town.players().map((p) => ({ p, d: Math.hypot(p.x - me.x, p.y - me.y) })).sort((a, b) => a.d - b.d); const who = by.at(0)?.p; if (!who) return 'nobody'; document.querySelector(`button[aria-label="Show where ${who.name} is"]`).click(); window.town.skip(0.4); return JSON.stringify(window.town.found()); })()
